verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document in-pipeline event transformation functions or custom code that can transform, filter, or enrich events before they reach destinations. Hightouch Events collects events and stores them in the warehouse, and the docs say that logic "moves to your warehouse." SQL/dbt models and data contracts are adjacent warehouse-modeling and governance features, not in-stream event transformations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can transform, filter, and enrich events in-pipeline with custom code or functions before they reach destinations
